_comment: THE ENTIRE BALANCE OF #294 LIVES IN THESE INGREDIENTS. The blueprint is permanent, so four
Broken Spawners buy spawners forever and there is no second lever - see the note on #36.
First pass, deliberately expensive: a cage of rebar around soul sand, with the sculk that
listens for something to be born. Every ingredient is depths-side or reclamation-side, so a
spawner cannot be assembled from household garbage alone.
